name: Nakagawa (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakagawa city emblem in green: a disc crossed by white wavy lines, like a river.
history: Municipal flag of Nakagawa, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 August 1973.

features.role: Nakagawa city emblem — a disc crossed by white wavy lines, like a river
